name: Stand-Up Comedy
description: End your weekend with a laugh at the iconic Bolhão market, which transforms into a comedy club for a night of stand-up.
longDescription:
This stand-up comedy event takes place on a Sunday evening, offering a program of comedic performances. The event is organized as a dedicated night for stand-up, featuring a lineup of comedians. It aims to provide an entertainment option for the close of the weekend.

Attendees can expect an evening focused on live comedy within the distinctive setting of Mercado do Bolhão. The market's main hall will host the performances, creating an unusual backdrop for a comedy show. The event is scheduled for approximately two hours. The language of the performances will be Portuguese.

Admission is ticketed. The Mercado do Bolhão is located in central Porto, easily accessible via public transport. The Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) is directly adjacent to the market. Several bus lines also stop nearby.
